narr: A mid to upper level low moved over a warm, moist airmass in South Central Texas and generated slow moving thunderstorms. Some of these storms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding that closed US 55 near Montell along the Nueces River. There were pictures of water over the road on social media.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding that closed US 55 south of Camp Wood along the Nueces River. A trained spotter sent pictures of water over the road.
